subject.title: fix(whatsapp): add listGroupsLive for real-time group directory

question: Which authenticated Gateway-owned seam should the standalone directory CLI use to query live WhatsApp group memberships?
rationale: The correct fix crosses a process and credential-ownership boundary; inventing a channel-specific socket or RPC without owner direction could conflict with the active Baileys session or create a parallel control-plane contract.

options.title: Generic Gateway directory RPC
options.body: Add a channel-agnostic authenticated directory method that invokes the installed plugin's live adapter inside the Gateway and lets the CLI fall back to static data when unreachable.

options.title: WhatsApp plugin Gateway action
options.body: Expose a narrower WhatsApp-owned authenticated action for group discovery, accepting the extra channel-specific control-plane surface.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Do not merge the static alias and leave the linked issue open until the intended Gateway query contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Generic Gateway directory RPC
recommendation.body: Add a channel-agnostic authenticated directory method that invokes the installed plugin's live adapter inside the Gateway and lets the CLI fall back to static data when unreachable.

likelyOwner.reason: The history most strongly connects this person to both WhatsApp runtime ownership and the generic directory boundary.
